messages:
maria: RFC follow-up: propose a precision 'safety lattice' (fp8 -> int8 -> 4bit) plus adaptive backoff based on telemetry and shadow evals. Need input on API, cache, and metrics.

sam: +1. Make lattice explicit in profile schema and add hysteresis thresholds to avoid oscillation.

leo: Runtime needs per-request negotiation and an `abort_on_fallback` flag. Crucial: include precision and profile_id in KV cache keys to prevent cross-precision reuse. Example key: `f\"{model}:{profile_id}:{precision}:{input_hash}\"`.

julia: Telemetry should emit per-node metrics: `model_loss`, `samples`, `fallbacks`, `avg_latency_ms`, `degradation_score`, tagged by `endpoint` and `canary_id`.

sam: Accept `degradation_score` from shadow evals as a policy signal: backoff when score > X for Y samples.

maria: UX: expose `safety_mode` enum (strict|managed|permissive). Strict = only pinned precisions. Managed = runtime can backoff. Permissive = allow lowest bitpaths. Recommend per-endpoint override metadata.

ops-bot: deploybot: staging canary fp8 shadowing since 05:00 UTC; fallback_rate=2.0% (24h), avg_latency +3ms, sample_count=14.

julia: Playbook: if `fallback_rate>1%` AND `avg_degradation_score>0.01` -> auto-rollback for canaries, page SRE for prod.

maria: Action items: (1) schema PR to add `precision_lattice` + thresholds (assign @sam), (2) runtime: include precision in cache keys, add `abort_on_fallback`, persist last-successful-precision + cooldown TTL (assign @leo), (3) telemetry: per-node metrics & alerts (assign @julia), (4) product: finalize `safety_mode` UX. I'll open the follow-up issue.

sam: I'll draft the schema. Using `precision_lattice` snake_case. PR snippet: `{"precision_lattice":[{"node_id":"fp8_v1","precision":"fp8","thresholds":{"degradation_score":0.005,"min_samples":100}},{"node_id":"int8_v1","precision":"int8","thresholds":{"degradation_score":0.02,"min_samples":50}},{"node_id":"4bit_v1","precision":"4bit","thresholds":{"degradation_score":0.06,"min_samples":20}}]}`

leo: Ensure backoff decisions are idempotent and metrics emitted atomically with state changes to aid debugging.

maria: Thanks everyone, I'll create issues and tag owners. Target: land schema PR this sprint and run shadow telemetry on staging.
